content:
pagerduty-bot: PAGERDUTY ALERT - High 5xx rate detected for customer AcmeFin on Dedicated cluster d-cluster-07. 5xx spike started ~1765032000. Service: redwood-runtime. Affected routes: /v1/generate (model: redwood-large-v1-dedicated).
Alex R: acked. I'm oncall. pulling up metrics now.

ops-bot: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-5xx (steps 1-6). Suggest starting with `runcmd cluster inspect d-cluster-07` and check queue lengths.

Alex R: running `runcmd cluster inspect d-cluster-07 --metrics --last 15m` now. CPU 96% on shard-3, GPU mem 98%, incoming RPS normal but queue length for model shard-3 is 320 (baseline ~5).

Alex R: tails from runtime logs show repeated `KV cache OOM` and `accept_request timeout=120s` from requests owned by customer AcmeFin tenant-id `acme-34`.

Mira K: looking. that tenant shipped a batch job yesterday that runs 1000s of small inference calls? Could be noisy neighbor. Any long-running sessions pinned?

Alex R: yes I see a handful of persistent sessions from `acme-34` pinned to shard-3 with sequence lengths ~4096. They spawned many concurrent shorter requests causing KV fill.

Samir P: pinging eng-runtime to confirm eviction path. If it's noisy neighbor, we can evict by forcing their sessions to fallback pool or throttle.

Mira K: agreed. Suggested mitigations, in order: 1) apply tenant-level throttle (limit concurrency to 5) 2) evict long-lived sessions for tenant 3) route new requests to fallback model variant redwood-large-v1-lite 4) enable burst autoscale for dedicated cluster.

Alex R: starting mitigation 1: `runcmd tenant throttle --tenant acme-34 --concurrency 5`

ops-bot: tenant throttle applied successfully.

Alex R: monitoring... queue dropped from 320 -> 110 in 90s. 5xx rate still elevated but trending down.

Julia L: I'm opening an infra ticket to evict sessions if throttling isn't enough. tagging @eng-infra.

Ben T: while that's happening, we should flip routing for AcmeFin's production route to `redwood-large-v1-lite` as a fallback for up to 10% of requests to reduce pressure. I can patch the routing rule.

Alex R: please do. `patch-traffic acme-34 /v1/generate --fallback redwood-large-v1-lite --percent 10`

Ben T: done. routing change deployed (canary) at 1765032300.

Alex R: after throttle + routing canary, 5xx rate from AcmeFin decreased 70% and latency improved from p95 2.8s -> 1.2s. Still seeing occasional gateway timeouts for streaming requests.

Mira K: looks like the underlying problem is a runaway customer job that pins huge KV cache for many sessions. We need to evict those sessions and restart the worker process on shard-3. I'll coordinate with eng-infra for a rolling restart to avoid full cluster outage.

Samir P: infra confirmed safe window. Proposed: evict tenant sessions on shard-3, restart runtime on shard-3, enable burst autoscale (+2 GPUs) for 10 minutes, then monitor.

Alex R: initiating eviction: `runcmd runtime evict-sessions --cluster d-cluster-07 --tenant acme-34 --shard shard-3 --force`

ops-bot: eviction job started (job id evict-1765032405).

Alex R: eviction logs: many sessions terminated, eviction rate ~120/s. Queue dropped to 8. GPU mem dropped to 45%.

Mira K: restart runtime on shard-3: `runcmd runtime restart --cluster d-cluster-07 --shard shard-3 --rolling` (expected ~60s to rejoin).

ops-bot: restart initiated. shard-3 offline for 42s. No other shards impacted.

Alex R: shard-3 back in service. health checks passing. p95 latency back to baseline 0.9s. 5xx rate returned to normal.

customer-success: notifying AcmeFin contact (via SRE->CS template): "We've mitigated an elevated 5xx incident affecting your Dedicated cluster d-cluster-07 by throttling a high-volume tenant job and evicting long-lived sessions. No data loss. We'll follow up with root cause and long-term mitigation."

Alex R: final mitigations: applied tenant concurrency limit until customer confirms job changes, added routing fallback at 10% permanent for that route, scheduled auto-eviction policy for tenants exceeding KV-cache quota, and raised alert thresholds to detect KV cache fill earlier.

Mira K: follow-ups created: ENG-RUNTIME-432 (auto-evict policy), ENG-INFRA-789 (eviction tooling improvements), CS-1234 (customer communication & remediation plan).

Samir P: handing off to next oncall (night): `Samir P` taking over monitoring and follow-up actions. If anything spikes again ping me @samir.

Alex R: thanks all. incident declared resolved at 1765035450. I'll write a short incident summary and link to postmortem.

Ben T: adding metric graphs and logs to incident doc.

pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED - 5xx spike mitigated. Duration: 12m 50s.

Alex R: cleanup tasks: remind AcmeFin to rework batch job, enable tenant quotas, schedule a sync with AcmeFin next week.

customer-success: will contact AcmeFin now and schedule the follow-up call.

Mira K: note for postmortem: consider per-tenant KV cache quotas and preemptive throttles for long-seq workloads.

Alex R: end of thread."
